messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGING: Per-tenant observability gap detected for dedicated pool dp-34 (tenant_id=praxisfinance). Symptoms: traces missing (span drop ~100%), partial log delivery, metrics shard lagging p95. Auto-alert -> severity: high. Runbook: /playbooks/obs/tenant-forwarder-fallback.
oncall-ryan: ack. I’m taking this. tagging infra and runtime. @eng-infra-ana @eng-runtime-eli please triage — is this a forwarder/bridge issue or a tenant routing partition?
sre-maya: I’m looking at the span index. For PraxisFinance we see no spans from 23:12:00 -> 23:25:00 across all ingesters for dp-34. Logs show some partial batches accepted but forwarder_client returns 504 on write. Metrics show a single metrics shard (shard-7) falling behind with a backlog.
eng-runtime-eli: Thanks. On dp-34 the serving nodes are fine, model traffic normal. This looks like comms between the dp-34 forwarder pool and the central observability bridge. We did a trivial TLS cert rotation last night; could be related.
eng-infra-ana: I’m on it. Checking forwarder fleet health. Preliminary: 2/6 forwarder instances in dp-34 reporting unhealthy to consul. The unhealthy nodes are hitting an auth error when calling the bridge host -> 401 from bridge proxy logs. Likely token expiration.
cust-eng-liz: FYI I opened an incident with PraxisFinance support contact (ticket #PF-4729). They’re seeing no traces in their tracing UI and are asking for ETA. Please capture impact statement for the ticket.
solutions-jamal: Quick impact note for support: "PraxisFinance: no tracing data between 23:12-23:25, partial log delivery, alerts may have missed errors in that window. No CPU/GC issues observed on inference nodes. Potential root cause: forwarder auth token expiry on dedicated pool dp-34."
sre-maya: Short mitigation options: 1) Rotate forwarder token (fast but requires infra help). 2) Re-route tenant via central fallback forwarder (non-disruptive to serving, ~3-4 min to activate). 3) If bridge proxy is overloaded, scale it (10-15min). I recommend immediate re-route to central fallback then rotate token as durable fix.
eng-infra-ana: I can push a temporary re-route. Need an approval to apply `obs.routing.override` for tenant praxisfinance -> central-forwarder for dp-34. Command: ```bash
# temporary route override
redwoodctl obs route apply --tenant praxisfinance --from dp-34 --to central-forwarder --ttl 30m
```
oncall-ryan: Please run the command and post results. Also add a short note to the runbook about doing this for dedicated pools — it's not in the current playbook.
eng-infra-ana: Running now.
eng-infra-ana: ```
$ redwoodctl obs route apply --tenant praxisfinance --from dp-34 --to central-forwarder --ttl 30m
Applying override... OK
Active routes for praxisfinance:
 - dp-34 -> central-forwarder (override, expires 2026-03-15T23:58:30Z)
```
sre-maya: Seeing traces reappear in staging trace index. Roughly 90s after apply we have spans flowing. Logs show batches being accepted again. Metrics backlog draining. :tada:
incident-bot: action_taken: temporary route override applied; severity remains high until token rotation confirmed.
eng-infra-ana: Next step: rotate forwarder token for dp-34 so we can remove override. Token rotation play: (1) generate short-lived forwarder token via KMS, (2) deploy to forwarder instances, (3) verify handshake. I’ll prepare commands.
eng-infra-ana: ```bash
# generate token
redwoodctl secrets create forwarder-token --scope dp-34 --ttl 1h --out-token /tmp/fwd.token
# deploy to nodes (ansible snippet)
ansible dp-34-forwarders -m copy -a "src=/tmp/fwd.token dest=/etc/obs/forwarder.token mode=0400"
# restart forwarder service
systemctl restart redwood-observability-forwarder
```
sre-maya: I can coordinate verification after deploy. Will watch traces/logs for auth errors and handshake ok.
oncall-ryan: @cust-eng-liz can you update PraxisFinance: short note that we re-routed telemetry to a central forwarder to restore visibility and we’re rotating tokens; ETA ~15-25min for full restoration. Keep language: we’re not changing customer data paths for inference, only observability.
cust-eng-liz: Will update now. Sending message: "We’ve re-routed your telemetry to a central collector to restore traces/logs — our team is rotating credentials and expect full visibility restored within 20 minutes. No inference impact to your workloads"
solutions-jamal: Also logging post-incident action items: add per-tenant forwarder token expiry monitor; add runbook step for re-route for dedicated pools; update on-call checklist.
oncall-ryan: Ok, once infra confirms token rotation, we’ll remove the temporary override and validate there’s no auth errors. If all green, we can downgrade severity. Handing to night on-call for longer term follow-up: @oncall-joseph you’ll take this for the 00:00 handover. Notes pinned.
oncall-joseph: acknowledged — I’ll monitor for the next 2 hours and validate bridging metrics and replay missing spans if needed.
eng-infra-ana: Token rotation completed. Deploy logs: ```
- copied token to 6 nodes
- restarted forwarder service
- last restart: 2026-03-15T23:39:12Z
```
Verification: forwarders showing healthy, bridge proxy auth OK.
sre-maya: Confirmed: no 401s in bridge logs after 23:39, traces are flowing normally for PraxisFinance, metrics backlog cleared. Marking mitigation complete.
oncall-ryan: Good work. I’m removing the override now.
eng-infra-ana: Removing override: ```
redwoodctl obs route delete --tenant praxisfinance --from dp-34 --to central-forwarder
Result: OK
```
sre-maya: Final sanity: traces persisted for the missing window (we replayed buffered batches from the forwarder; spans show up with ingestion timestamps). Customer-facing impact: gap narrowed — we recovered ~95% of spans for the window; a small subset of events were lost due to timeouts in the forwarder during the outage.
cust-eng-liz: Update to PraxisFinance: "Visibility restored, most traces recovered; a small fraction (<5%) of events from 23:12-23:25 may be missing. We’ve implemented a token rotation and added monitoring to prevent recurrence. Support ticket PF-4729 will remain open for 48h to monitor"
solutions-jamal: Postmortem items: - add per-tenant token expiry alert, - healthcheck that validates forwarder handshake post-cert rotate, - include route-override steps in runbook, - automate replay for buffered batches.
oncall-ryan: Downgrading severity to low, marking incident as mitigated. Leaving notes for handoff. Thanks everyone. :bowing_man: 
oncall-joseph: Taking it from here. Will follow up on postmortem items tomorrow.
incident-bot: incident_closed: mitigation applied, temporary route removed, customer notified. Log refs: logs://dp-34/forwarder/2026-03-15/23:30-23:45, traces://praxisfinance/ingest/2026-03-15.
